annotations.title: Make an Arabic, Urdu or Persian PDF

description: Create a PDF from Arabic, Urdu or Persian text, or text that mixes them with English, with every letter correctly joined, lines running right to left, and numbers, dates, phone numbers and Latin words kept in order. Suited to PDFs, printable files, letters, notices, invoices, certificates, menus and handouts in Arabic, Urdu or Persian. The text is printed exactly as given; light Markdown is supported: '# ' headings, blank lines between paragraphs, '- ' bullets, '1. ' numbered lists, '| a | b |' tables (a '|---|' row marks a header) and **bold**. Returns a download link that works for 24 hours. It only lays out text: it does not write, translate or change wording, and it does not make images.

archival.description: Export as PDF/A-2a with PDF/UA-1 (archival and accessible), falling back to PDF/A-2b.
